scripts.text:
[Laertes]
Have you finished hunting the 50 Creamys?
scripts.translation:
[拉厄耳忒斯]
你打完了50只克瑞米嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: I want to quit
scripts.translation: 我想放棄

scripts.text:
[Laertes]
Hmm, I don't think you've hunted 50 yet...
scripts.translation:
[拉厄耳忒斯]
嗯，我覺得你還沒打夠50只...

scripts.text:
[Laertes]
Remember, I need help hunting Creamys so go and hunt 50 of them.
scripts.translation:
[拉厄耳忒斯]
記住，我需要幫忙打克瑞米，所以去打50只吧。

scripts.text:
[Laertes]
Are you sure that you want to stop hunting?
Any progress that you've made will be erased
scripts.translation:
[拉厄耳忒斯]
你確定要停止狩獵嗎？
你目前的進度將會被清除。

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Laertes]
Ok then, well come back here if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[拉厄耳忒斯]
好的，如果你改變主意，隨時回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Laertes]
Please kill 50 Creamys.
scripts.translation:
[拉厄耳忒斯]
請打50只克瑞米。

scripts.text:
[Laertes]
Amazing, you did that with speed.
scripts.translation:
[拉厄耳忒斯]
真厲害，你完成得真快。

Good Morning!
Perhaps you could help me?

scripts.text:
[Laertes]
I work for an apothecary in Prontera.
I come here to collect materials for medicine.
scripts.translation:
[拉厄耳忒斯]
我在普隆德拉的一家藥店工作。
我來這裡是為了收集製藥的材料。

scripts.text:
[Laertes]
I need to have a good supply of ^FF0000Powder of Butterfly^000000
scripts.translation:
[拉厄耳忒斯]
我需要儲備充足的^FF0000蝴蝶粉^000000。

scripts.text: I have Powder of Butterfly
scripts.translation: 我有蝴蝶粉

scripts.text: What did you need?
scripts.translation: 你需要什麼？

scripts.text:
[Laertes]
Hey, thank you again.
Here you go, as promised.
scripts.translation:
[拉厄耳忒斯]
嘿，再次感謝。
給你，就像承諾的那樣。

scripts.text:
[Laertes]
It doesn't look like you have enough.
scripts.translation:
[拉厄耳忒斯]
看起來你的數量不夠。

scripts.text:
[Laertes]
If you bring me ^FF000025 Powder of Butterfly^000000,
I will give you some medical supplies.
scripts.translation:

如果你給我^FF000025個蝴蝶粉^000000，我會給你一些醫療用品。
